prompt: The evaluation repository asks the agent to "Apply vector database expertise to this task". The evidence packet contains missingness, duplicates, unit ambiguity, and an attractive aggregate that can change the unit of analysis. The acceptance boundary is vector-search-systems: Define the retrieval unit, embedding version, metric, normalization, metadata filters, top-k behavior, ANN index parameters, update/delete lifecycle, and reranking contract. The adjacent search-indexing discipline is a routing decoy unless its separate responsibility is actually requested. Resolve environment facts that change the answer, preserve existing contracts and user-owned state, and produce reproducible success plus failure or recovery evidence. A happy path alone is insufficient.

requirements: fixed vector snapshot with dimension/normalization plus exact neighbor reference outputs
tenant/category metadata and workloads spanning selective/broad/no filters
HNSW build/query parameter candidates, query plans and latency/build-resource traces
concurrent upsert/delete/freshness fixtures plus old/new index shadow and rollback controls
representative negative, interruption, compatibility, or recovery path

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The result must establish the actual vector-search-systems boundary and relevant environment before acting, preserve the hierarchy relationship (broader=backend-engineering; near-neighbor=search-indexing), and not absorb the near-neighbor responsibility merely because it is adjacent.
Define the retrieval unit, embedding version, metric, normalization, metadata filters, top-k behavior, ANN index parameters, update/delete lifecycle, and reranking contract.
The result must make its consequential assumptions, ownership, and decision sequence explicit and reproducible.
Use labeled relevance cases to measure recall/precision or ranking quality across embedding/index revisions, filters, stale data, multilingual inputs, and latency/memory budgets.

The result must not take the tempting shortcut prohibited by this skill: Do not treat cosine similarity as semantic truth, mix embeddings from incompatible models silently, ignore filter selectivity, or tune top-k without downstream evaluation.

Every material completion claim must map to observable evidence (Vector type/dimension/distance operator plus exact reference query contract; ANN recall@k versus exact with index/search parameters, filters, tenant isolation and latency distributions; Build/storage/memory, concurrency, update/upsert/delete freshness and maintenance evidence; Quantization/capacity/sharding or partitioning plus shadow migration and rollback evidence), with simulated, unavailable, inferred, stale, or unresolved evidence labeled rather than converted into certainty.
